blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a deliberate single-hue blue palette and well-organized grid layout elevate it above generic defaults, but 9px network labels and nearly imperceptible typography hierarchy between panel labels and content keep it short of publication quality.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt for bubble sizing in both network and color panels, zero-baseline bar chart with data-driven domain, fixed HCL color-space axes (0–360 hue, 0–100 lightness) are semantically correct, no dual-axis abuse or radius deception.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, no feedback loops or stale scales, but the color brush constructs expensive blockIndices Set joins synchronously on every mousemove before the deferred render.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-filtered views stay within working memory limits, the monochromatic blue network (60 nodes, density-pruned) reads clearly, and the force layout is pre-computed so there's no animation chaos — the only friction is the color scatter's density (many small dots), which is intentional but requires a moment to parse the hue×lightness encoding.
